name: AHONEN & LAMBARG
introduction: Ahonen & Lamberg is a multidisciplinary design studio based in Paris. Founded in 2006 by Finnish designers Anna Ahonen and Katariina Lamberg, it concentrates on art direction, creative consultancy and graphic design. Ahonen & Lamberg operates in the fields of fashion, culture and publishing. The studio counts among its clients Adidas, Aldo, Carven, Cerruti, Diesel, H&M, Isetan, Kitsuné, Lacoste, Printemps, Wallpaper*.
